reference: Wang et al., Phys. Rev. C 88, 024306 (2013)

summary.lineage_to_falsified_reading: Wang 2013 justified the chiral doublet assignment of Bands A and B by citing Joshi 2007 (Ref. 17) in 106Ag. In 106Ag, subsequent DSAM lifetimes (Lieder 2014, Bark 2024) proved that the exact same 4 hbar alignment jump represents a 2qp to 4qp band crossing, definitively refuting chirality.
summary.lifetime_absence: No DSAM or RDDS lifetimes exist for Bands A and B in 104Ag; absolute B(M1) and B(E2) values are completely unmeasured.
summary.methodological_boundary: In the absence of DSAM lifetime measurements, cross-isotope phenomenological analogies risk propagating falsified 2qp/4qp crossing interpretations as spurious chiral doublet candidates.
